title: Private deploy field notes - ACME Corp (on-prem) prep
content:
Context:
- Customer: ACME Corp (regulated finance). On-prem deployment behind customer firewall + private control plane.
- Goal: prep runbook and blockers before Wed site visit (week of 2026-03-09). Quick notes after calls w/ infra & security.

High-level checklist (quick):
- Network: confirm CIDR ranges, NAT, DNS, proxy rules
- Access: customer ops SSH jump host + service accounts
- GPUs: confirm node driver (NVIDIA) + CUDA + container runtime versions
- Storage: NFS mount points / CSI plugin + performance profile
- Secrets: KMS/HSM integration + disk encryption proof points
- Installer: air-gapped container registry / offline bundle tested
- Telemetry: metrics/trace egress policy (only to control plane endpoints)
- SLA: expected throughput and canary rollout plan

Notes from call (2026-03-03):
- ACME expects no outbound to internet except to our control plane IPs (we were given a list of IPs to allow). Need to verify those with ops.
- They use a Palo Alto firewall with strict egress rules; customer will add firewall rules but wants exact FQDNs/IPs + ports.
- They have an HSM for keywrap; security team wants us to support PKCS#11 or at minimum show integration docs.
- Storage team wants ephemeral SSD for model cache + NFS for long-term artifacts (must size PVCs).
- Ops uses RedHat 8.6 with docker-ce currently; preferred container runtime for us is containerd. Check compatibility.

Action items (me):
- [ ] Finalize list of control-plane IPs + FQDNs for firewall rules (ask infra/ops).  Due 2026-03-05.
- [ ] Build offline bundle (tar + registry images) and smoke test in lab air-gapped environment.  Estimate 1 day.
- [ ] Verify CUDA + driver matrix: target CUDA 12.x, nvidia-driver >= 535.
- [ ] Helm values template for ACME (custom storageClass, nodeSelectors, tolerations).
- [ ] Draft KMS integration notes (HSM PKCS#11 flow) for security review.
- [ ] Prepare canary rollout plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with automatic fallback.
- [ ] Update install checklist with exact ports: SSH 22, K8s API 6443 (if applicable), registry ports 5000/443, metrics destination 443.

Commands & quick snippets to try (lab):
- Check GPU driver: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
- Containerd install snippet (RHEL): yum install -y containerd && systemctl enable --now containerd
- Offline registry push (example): skaffold/registry -> docker save -> scp -> docker load -> tag/push
- Helm install (values override): helm upgrade --install redwood ./chart -f values-acme.yaml --set global.storageClass=fast-ssd

Install/edge-case blockers to raise ASAP:
- HSM drivers: customer uses Thales nShield; need compatibility matrix. Security says if PKCS#11 not supported, fallback is customer-managed envelope encryption (extra TODO).
- Air-gap: some images currently reference public alpine or debian repos in init containers (need to vendor all base images).
- Proxy: their outbound proxy does TLS interception; cert pinning for control-plane endpoints may break. Need guidance from platform on cert pinning options.
- SELinux: customer enforces SELinux in enforcing mode; confirm our init containers and CSI drivers run under strict SELinux contexts.

Performance/size notes:
- Model cache disk: recommend 2x size of largest model (~100GB) => request 200GB ephemeral SSD per GPU node group.
- NFS perf: ask customer to provision large-IO NFS or consider Ceph/Rook if they need high throughput.

Customer contacts:
- Ops: Priya Singh (ops@acme.example) - firewall, jump hosts
- Sec: Mateo Ruiz (sec@acme.example) - HSM, compliance
- Infra: Li Wei (infra@acme.example) - storage, node images

Meeting prep (for on-site):
- Bring: offline bundle on encrypted thumbdrive + install checklist printouts
- On-site tasks: run full air-gap install in staging network, validate model load, run throughput test (100 concurrent small requests), verify metrics sent to control plane but no other egress.

Questions for infra/eng team (internal):
- Can we expose a minimal set of ports/FQDNs that ACME can whitelist instead of entire repo IP ranges? (ask infra network team)
- Is there an existing PKCS#11 adapter in our secret-manager integration? If not, what's the ETA?
- Who owns the SELinux testing matrix? Need a CI job that runs our container images under SELinux enforcing.

References / useful links:
- Confluence: ACME on-prem onboarding (linked: CONFLUENCE:ACME-onprem-env)
- Installer PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/87
- JIRA: PD-2143 (ACME on-prem prep)
- Slack thread: #private-deploys (search "ACME" thread pinned)

Quick timeline suggestion:
- 2026-03-04: finalize IP/FQDN list + offline bundle build started
- 2026-03-05: test air-gap install in lab, smoke model load
- 2026-03-06: iterate on HSM notes + confirm with security
- 2026-03-09 (on-site): full install with customer, finalize go/no-go checklist

Random notes / scratch (do not forget):
- customer wants audit logs retained 7 years -> ask compliance for evidence package
- check license text for any redistributions (OSS images) before shipping offline bundle
- make values-acme.yaml include: nodeSelector: { gpu: "true" }, tolerations: [{ key: "nvidia.com/gpu", effect: "NoSchedule" }]

End of scratchpad.
